title: Sweet BBQ Sauce
steps: Mix all ingredients in a pot and simmer about 20 minutes, until flavors combine.
Remove from heat. Once cool, refrigerate in an airtight jar or bottle. The source says it should keep for months.
reviewFlags: This formula appears in a source titled “Failed BBQ Sauces”; its refrigerated storage duration needs confirmation. The source states that ounce measures are by volume.
